shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل

notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Sufyan (named in both); the tail عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل، محمد ابن الحنفية، علي is written once and belongs to both.
The Prophet is the end of the chain and is not a link (rule 12); Ali is the last link.
Tirmidhi's own remarks («قال أبو عيسى» ...) are not chains and are left out.
